about: The mutant ledger of the IR build path's coverage and agreement tooling (internal/experimental/irspike and the IR builder in internal/sketch/lower/ir*.go). Its killers need the IR toolchains or the full tier; see toolchain/ir/ports.md. Without the toolchains (ERGO_IRSPIKE_GOROOT_SOURCE, ERGO_IRSPIKE_GOROOT_IR, ERGO_IRSPIKE_CACHE) the agreement tests skip and their rows survive, so run the ledger with the toolchains set. The patch-level mutant port-stock-not-identical (a planted codegen change outside the -ergoir guard) is an edit of the Go patch, run with scripts/irport -patch, not here. The derivative's own mutants live outside this repository and are recorded here by name only (go-irspike, wf10 IR1 round 1): M1 the decoder swaps binary operands, M2 drops the else branch, M4 the IR path builds with bounds checks off (-B), all killed by TestIRMatchesSource; M6 the decoder accepts a type mismatch, killed by TestIRBodyThatDoesNotCheck; M7 (MISCOMPILE-1) the decoder's un case without the parenthesized binary operand, so Go's writer (staticBool) folds `if !(p && false)` as never taken, killed by TestIRReprosMatchSource (notand: pick gives 8, not 1) and TestIRUnaryOperandsMatchSource (seed 1); M8 (IRFIX-FLOAT) the decoder's const case without the exact value of a negative float64 constant, so -1e-12 compiles to the rounded float64 while Go keeps -1/10^12 on the negation its text spells, killed by TestIRTextRepros (negfloat) and TestIRTextChecks on raytrace; F1's M8 (wf10 FLIP F1, a second M8 beside IRFIX-FLOAT's) the decoder resolves a generic function's own type parameters but not its receiver's, so a method of a generic record whose body names T does not build, killed by TestIRGenericsMatchSource (Box.Or: "T" is not a type); IRFIX-TEXT's printer and shape mutants, each killed by TestIRTextRepros (printed) and TestIRTextChecks on pipeline: MT1 a composite literal's type printed in parentheses ((struct{…}){…}: cannot parenthesize type in composite literal), MT2 a body placed after the line of EndPos(signature), inside a multi-line struct result type (unexpected { in struct type), MT3 a shape's types keep their function types' parameter and result names (a function literal's names in the text, none in the IR), MT4 a method value's signature keeps its receiver's names in the shape (the IR's selector keeps the method's receiver); IR2-RESULTS's MR, the decoder ignores an IR function's results flag (no named result bound as a local), has no killer until a lowered body sets the flag (GP's fallible frame, F7-gp-frame), whose unit names it. PATCH-MIN M4 (the reader in its own package cmd/compile/internal/ergoir, noder's adapter noder/ergoir_hook.go): M4a ergoir.Stub drops its shape-only branch (the text build writes no shapes for the text check), killed by TestIRTextRepros; M4b noder's ergoFlag is a struct of its own, not ergoir.Flag (irgen.go's generic-body hooks never see -ergoir), killed by TestIRGenericsMatchSource. TestIRRuntimeChecks (race detector, GC checkmark) was deleted in batch-18 fix-tool: it guarded only the derivative's stack and pointer maps, and no mutant of this repository reached it.
